answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 26396 Country: India Title: My mothers & my application has been selected for Haj this year 2010. My mother who is 64 yrs has Urinary problem & she cannot with hold for long period due to Knee joint problems & some times urinates in the clothes.Can she use adult diapers & complete her Haj. I donot have money for Haj, can I borrow money interest free from other than Muslim & complete our Haj & repay them Question: Assalaamaliakum My mothers & my application has been selected for Haj this year 2010. My mother who is 64 yrs has Urinary problem & she cannot with hold for long period due to Knee joint problems & some times urinates in the clothes.Can she use adult diapers & complete her Haj. I donot have money for Haj, can I borrow money interest free from other than Muslim & complete our Haj & repay them Answer ID: 26396 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1859/1480/B=1431) Yes, your mother can use adult diaper and perform her hajj. But, if the urine gets into the adult diaper making it impure, then she cannot perform tawaf in this state. In order to perform tawaf she will have to clean the impurity and have wudhu. She can perform other rituals of hajj. It is alright to perform hajj by debt money, hajj shall be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
